model_annotation:
This figure contains two vertically stacked line plots illustrating training rewards over training steps for two different methods on two different difficulty levels of a training set.

The top plot is titled "Easy Training Set." The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and spans a linear scale, though specific tick values are not shown on this subplot. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4. Two lines are displayed. The blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts near 0.0 at the beginning of training, rises steeply through approximately the first quarter of the x-axis range to reach values around 0.25–0.30, and then continues to increase more gradually, plateauing around 0.35–0.40 in the latter portion of the plot. The red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," follows a similar trajectory, starting near 0.0, rising steeply in the early steps, and reaching values around 0.30–0.35 toward the end, though it appears to remain slightly below the blue line for much of the later training period. Both lines are shown with shaded regions indicating variability or confidence intervals.

The bottom plot is titled "Hard Training Set." The x-axis is labeled "Steps" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at intervals of 100 (0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500). The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.2. Two lines are displayed. The blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," remains near 0.0 throughout the entire training duration, showing essentially no increase in reward across all 500 steps. The red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," starts near 0.0 and begins to show a gradual upward trend starting around step 50–100, fluctuating between approximately 0.05 and 0.10 through the middle portion of training, and then continuing to rise more noticeably after step 300, reaching values around 0.15–0.20 by step 500. Both lines include shaded regions around them representing variability.
